segments.title: How far is this atoll from ANYONE?
segments.say: How far is this atoll from the nearest island where people live? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: About 385 KM!
segments.say: About three hundred eighty five kilometers! It's Bokak atoll, in the Marshall Islands.

segments.title: Barely touched by people
segments.say: It's barely touched by people, so scientists surveyed it to see a wild reef.

segments.title: 15 seabird colonies
segments.say: They counted fifteen seabird colonies across two remote atolls.

segments.title: 266+ kinds of reef fish
segments.say: And more than two hundred sixty six kinds of reef fish.

segments.title: Source: Frontiers study
segments.say: The study came out this month.
Follow for Guess It number 30 tomorrow.
